Further searching judged low value for a plain, mid-value furniture lot. eBay sold not reachable and would add little.
viewing_check: Look at the timber: Huon pine is pale golden with fine close grain, faint birdseye and a resinous smell when scratched on an unseen edge; this one looks redder, so check the underside and back boards for cedar (open coarse grain, red) or blackwood. Check for veneer, replaced shelf or top, repairs, borer, and any drawer or label. If it is true Huon with 19th century age, expect around $300-600 hammer at best; if cedar or stained pine, closer to $150-250.
